references.name: Momento · Exterior corner
references.notes: Observed: blue brick street face with three windows, solid blue sign infill on chamfered corner, opaque blue side door and separate glazed entrance. Proposed shell is 9 by 8 source-grid cells with a 3-cell SE chamfer, oriented to show both street fronts in the isometric camera. Dimensions, rear walls and connection behind the side door are inferred. No measured grid scale. Current textures/window heights are provisional; not a passed fidelity review.

annotations.label: Three facade windows
annotations.notes: Observed: three separate dark-framed windows along the blue brick street face. Current window heights and blue color remain approximate.

annotations.label: Closed corner sign panel
annotations.notes: Observed: blue brick infill with painted logo, no door leaf or handle. Preserve solid chamfered corner. Current plain blue brick is an unfinished material study.

annotations.label: Blue side door
annotations.notes: Observed: opaque blue side door. Whether it is a normal customer route is unconfirmed; internal connection is inferred.

annotations.label: Glazed street entrance
annotations.notes: Observed: separate glazed opening to the right of the blue door. Adopted customer entrance for the walkable study; use requires route validation.

references.name: Momento · Coffee bar
references.source: Beezy Studio · Studio Hoon · ArchDaily gallery 3 · photograph _6
references.notes: Observed: dark curved timber counter, grinder, espresso machine, kettle and cups; white brick walls, grey tiled floor, pendant lights, hanging plant and exposed ceiling conduits. Hidden service clearances and exact dimensions remain unknown.

annotations.label: Service counter
annotations.notes: Shared subject: service-counter. Dark vertical timber cladding, rounded front corner and returning side. Same counter as Counter reverse; not a second assembly. Dimensions are not measured.

annotations.label: Coffee grinder
annotations.notes: Shared subject: coffee-grinder. Hopper, cylindrical body and tapered stand. Same machine as Counter reverse.

annotations.label: Espresso machine
annotations.notes: Visible behind the grinder along the counter return. Stacked cups above. Exact spacing and operating clearance are inferred.

annotations.label: Front pendant
annotations.notes: Dark conical pendant with warm interior above the front counter. Ceiling-supported; must not become a floor obstacle.

references.name: Momento · Adjoining wall
references.source: Beezy Studio · Studio Hoon · ArchDaily gallery 5 · photograph _9
references.notes: Observed: dark doorway on a raised threshold, brown wall panel, full-height curtain, exposed conduit and adjacent coffee equipment. The room behind the door and the area behind the curtain are unknown; do not assign a bathroom or storage function without more evidence.

annotations.label: Raised dark door
annotations.notes: Dark door on a raised threshold beside the bar. The space behind is not visible; do not label it a bathroom. Internal partition and threshold are still missing from the draft.

annotations.label: Brown wall panel
annotations.notes: Broad brown panel beside dark door, with visible conduit above. Right curtain is a separate fixture; hidden connection remains unknown.

references.name: Momento · Counter reverse
references.source: Beezy Studio · Studio Hoon · ArchDaily photograph _8
references.notes: Observed: twin dark-framed windows, continuous sill, wall-mounted product shelves, tall cabinet, menu board and cups on curved counter, grinder, ceiling spots and pendant. Grinder and counter match the coffee-bar view; approximate camera relationship needs annotation.

annotations.label: Service counter
annotations.notes: Shared subject: service-counter. Reverse side of the rounded counter; menu and cups sit on its surface. Lower/right extent is cropped.

annotations.label: Coffee grinder
annotations.notes: Shared subject: coffee-grinder. Opposite side of the same grinder. Keep one supported scene object.

annotations.label: Paired windows and sill
annotations.notes: Two adjacent tall dark-framed windows separated by a white brick pier. A continuous sill runs below both. Do not merge into one uninterrupted glass sheet.

annotations.label: Product display shelves
annotations.notes: Open wall-mounted shelves left of the paired windows. Packages and display objects visible; precise package identities unknown.
